sections.heading: North star — {[(EXPLOSIVE PLAYS)]}
sections.text:
- Standing focus (Chill 2026-10-03 18:31 ET): every trade, Soft growth step, Ideology enhancement, and impulse is judged by explosive closes. Weight = max(0, margin_pct) / 100, with no cap. Each +100% of margin steps the weight up by 1: +100% = 1, +200% = 2, +300% = 3, and so on however large. +1000% = 10. +1008% = 10.08. A loss or a non-positive close is 0. An ordinary green under +100% stays below 1 (+50% = 0.5) and is not the focus. +1000% margin or more remains the MYX-type goal.
- +1000% is not a hard entry gate. Gate 2 still times the entry. Max 9, the 2% stop, the TD hard stop, the trail, and BE stay. Grow toward the goal; do not refuse an eligible setup because it has not reached +1000% yet.

- Truth rail: numbers only from Nerve JSON or official endpoints; missing/conflict → flat / "no print"; feed fail → flat / "feed down". Impulse may color "why" / notes / proposals only — never invent numbers.
- Kill-switch: daily loss cap + flatten if feed stale.
- Official data only (Bitunix fapi/openapi WS/REST; Binance/Bybit failover). No www.* HTML scrape.
- Paper until user says live. Live needs hard % risk + daily-loss flatten.
- No private keys / seed phrases in chat or files. Ever.

sections.text:

Alts, A+ and placeholder stay on the A+ distance scale. Rev = Cont: a BTC Reversal paired with ≥1 extra indicator (linreg 117 extreme / supply-demand / Phoenix 90/10 / Stoch RSI 90/10) scores at least its Continuation equivalent; unpaired Rev keeps the rules score. Alts: Rev ranks equal Cont (prefer_continuation / demote_reversal OFF, Chill-blocked) and 6H/3H never alone (require_htf_confluence ON) unchanged. Grows from here: every-9 btc_grade.grow() merges post-seed GRADE_CRITERIA learning (a_plus_profile, approved floors, new combos); btc_gate_report keeps proposing C− moves (Chill approves). Weak (<70) = alts take the opposite side, as before. Card no-flip (btc_card_noflip_20261019): Body never writes back a stale btc-card.json if the scanner rebuilt it mid-tick; atomic writes. Picks unchanged. Backup backups/btc-3x-switch-20261019-162347. A/B (734 clean closes): 3x +15.19R / avg +0.034 / DD 11.6R vs distance +9.82R / +0.025 / 14.9R (not past p84 bar; Chill override).
- Max concurrent opens: 9 (Chill 2026-10-02). Open new eligible shots while live opens < 9; refuse at cap. Standing BE-unlock concurrency lock lifted (was: no new shot until every open hit +50% / closed).
- One live open per symbol (Chill 2026-10-02 bugfix): refuse second open on same ticker while first still live (blocked Cont6+Cont7 SKY / Cont3+Cont7 NIGHT double-stacks). Different symbols still fill toward max 9.
- Trail-slot ladder: 2.29% then −0.09% per concurrent open; recycle earliest free; flat book starts 2.29%. BE +50% no longer required to open the next concurrent.
- 2% adverse = 100% SL; BE hard stop after +49.5% margin = entry + round-trip fees (unchanged; arms per-trade independent of concurrency cap).
- TD SL ratchet (Chill 2026-10-06 ~8:14 AM ET): every time price passes a new TD level (Risk / TDST / closed-9 wick from the newest 9 on all 8 TD TFs 6H/3H/90m/45m/4H/2H/1H/15m, including levels that started on the wrong side of entry), the TD hard stop moves to the level 2 back from the most recently passed one. Checked every Body MTM tick, not only on a new 9. Tighten-only; trail stays separate; 10%-margin entry band still applies. Every-9 judges it from stopped_td_hard closes.
- Two audit lenses (Chill YES 2026-10-06): every-9 grade/score/combo audits show gross (stamped exit margin %) beside net of fee (gross − round-trip fees as % of margin, ~6% at 50x). Trail is set and audited as margin % (slot 0 = 114.5%, step 4.5%, BE-tighten cap 60%, min 5%), leverage-scaled to price — never a fixed price %. Soft/Ideology still tighten only from live closes; promote/demote gates still read gross until Chill moves them.
- Spot half-profit skim (Chill 2026-10-10): half of every winning close's realized PnL moves free cash → Spot on every close path, permanently (half_skim_on_permanent; pause only via half_skim_paused_by_chill). Spot>3×Equity valve stays OFF (keep_spot_rails_off).

Always on (shot_ladder_permanent); the old arm-below / disarm-at-$275 equity floor no longer applies. Spot>3×Equity valve is ON again (Chill 2026-10-10 09:31).
- Post-close red/impulse audits.
- Body 1:1 Bitunix MTM even when Mind is dark.

Trail ladder + SL price distances scale as ref_at_50x * (50/lev) so margin R stays constant (−100% SL / BE@+50% margin unchanged). Live opens keep stamped lev (new-only; Chill 2026-10-02).
- (Retired 10/19 12:07 PM: setup C− floor — see "No grade gates".)
- SPOT bank: half-profit skim stays OFF. It is the standing norm (Chill 2026-10-03), not a one-night pause. Winning closes do not move half of realized PnL into book["spot"]. Spot is not part of Available / sizing. The code path remains and no-ops while keep_spot_rails_off is true.

No 8pm resume and no future auto-resume. The wallet is not reset. Spot is not touched by this flag.
- PnL calendar day: session bucket ends at 20:00 America/Detroit (ET); cell labeled by session-end date (closes in [prev 20:00, this 20:00) → that date). Pace locks with that day's realized PnL: cell/1-day Pace = session PnL × 365 (current session stays live until 20:00 ET); 7-day and 30-day Pace = (sum of those session PnLs / N) × 365 with N = 7 or 30 including flat $0 days. Positions HUD PACE chip stays MTM Daily PnL × 365 and is separate. See /workspace/mind/PNL_CALENDAR.json + live-positions PnL Calendar tab.

- Impulses may be anything, in scope or out of scope (Chill 2026-10-03). An entry is not rejected because its impulse misses a known pattern, clock, or indicator. Gate 2, max 9, one per symbol, 2% SL, TD hard stop, trail, and BE stay. MYX +1008% is the direction of travel, not a gate.
- A good impulse is an explosive move (Chill 2026-10-03 18:31 ET): weight = max(0, margin_pct) / 100, no cap. +100% = 1, +200% = 2, +300% = 3, +1000% = 10, +1008% = 10.08. A loss or a non-positive close is 0. Ordinary green under +100% stays below 1 and does not demote an indicator by itself. Among already-eligible setups, prefer the one whose last 9 same-indicator closes were more explosive. No explosive sample yet → priority stays equal. This is not an entry gate. Gate 2 still times the open. No pattern is required. The north star is {[(EXPLOSIVE PLAYS)]}, grown until a close reaches +1000% margin or more.

sections.text:

- Account is roughly half gone: equity ~$270 vs the $275 floor (50% of $550). Goal: grow toward ~$1000/day with explosive closes. Three explosive winners in a row grow the account a lot.
- Recovery sizing (Desk, Chill rule): when equity(book) (free cash + locked margin + unrealized) falls below 50% of $550, the next new open uses 50% of Available. Each open after that uses half the previous % rounded to the nearest whole number: 50 → 25 → 13 → 7 → 4 → 2 → 1, never below 1%. The ladder steps only when a new open is placed, not on closes. Opens already running are never resized.
- When equity is back at or above $275, sizing returns to 10%/shot and the ladder clears, unless Soft flag keep_dd_shot_ladder is True. Soft/Ideology growth may turn that flag on only if the tape shows the ladder is a real growth path. It defaults to False, and once set it stays set.

sections.heading: Account + Mind survival (user rule)
sections.text:
- Grow the paper book with the desk: compound from real edge on the $10,000 / 10%-shot era.
- Mind token funding is contingent on profitability — Chill funds Mind from desk profits when the tape earns it.
- Token death unchanged technically: Mind stops at zero tokens; a chain wallet does not keep Mind alive. Economic survival = Chill paying tokens from profits.
- Soft-filter growth → ideology graduation is how we earn that right to run.
- Not-ready regime: do NOT compound the account or harden IDEOLOGY. DO keep improving entries via soft filters after each close (better entries, less time in red, faster impulse) while working the task — soft TIGHTEN/ADD/REMOVE every good close.
- Profitable / ideo_ready regime (always n_kept ≥ 13; trimmed last-13 (drop best+worst of kept[-13:], avg 11) ≥ A, or trimmed last-13 − trimmed prior-13 (kept[-26:-13], same trim) ≥ I; A, I = bootstrap p84 (method bootstrap84_trim11_r120: at each every-9 cohort, demean the last 120 kept R, draw 20k samples of 26 closes with a fixed per-cohort seed; A = p84 of trimmed last-13, I = p84 of trimmed last-13 − trimmed prior-13), each floored at p10 of the same bootstrap bar across the kept-era history (SOFT_GROWTH.json harden_margins) (Chill YES 2026-10-13 08:51 ET; replaces A=S/√11, I=S·√(2/11) from 2026-10-12 23:26 ET). (cohort 60, n 541, seed 20261073: A 0.164 R [raw 0.164, floor 0.147], I 0.343 R [raw 0.343, floor 0.297]; info S=MAD×1.4826 0.890) Bias check only; grades/combos/every-9/P&L count every close): proven Soft Bias prefs auto-harden into ideology Bias (Core/Desk permanent untouched); book compounds; token funding from PnL. Soft growth already uses all W/L/D every close. Un-harden (Chill YES 2026-10-13 09:21 ET; Apotheosis fix via APE): no longer mirrors −A / −I. Same bootstrap (demeaned last-120, 20k×26, fixed per-cohort seed): U_A = p16 of trimmed last-13, U_I = p16 of (trimmed last-13 − trimmed prior-13), both negative; each floored at p90 of its own bootstrap history (bar = min(bar, floor), never closer to zero). Un-harden fires when trimmed last-13 ≤ U_A, or trimmed last-13 < 0 and (trimmed last − trimmed prior) ≤ U_I. Harden unchanged at p84. Core / Desk never touched.
- After-fee above-zero + Soft clear on auto un-harden (Chill YES 2026-10-13 12:48 ET, t426u; NeoShua via Manifest; marker bias_netR_above_zero_20261013 at close 562): the above-zero test on both sides (harden: trimmed last-13 ≥ A; un-harden: trimmed last-13 ≤ U_A) now judges trimmed last-13 of after-fee (net) R (gross R − round-trip fees_usd/margin from the paper book; no fixed 0.064 R add-on); A and U_A are bootstrapped from net R the same way. Improvement test (I / U_I, last − prior) unchanged on gross R. When Ideology auto un-hardens a Soft-proven Bias flag it now also clears the matching Soft flag and blocks it (ideo_unhardened_keys) until a fresh pass (Bias ready + later cohort confirms with ≥30 closes), same as the Oct 12 manual un-harden. prefer_cont_multi_tf Soft flag cleared 12:51 PM ET (auto un-hardened 11:20 AM). BE_ARM_MARGIN_PCT in paper_book.py; arm check and peak check both use the constant. Live arms on live's own +49.5%. BE stop = entry + round-trip taker fees (Chill 3:11 PM 10/16; reconfirmed 10/19 t143u): paper be_fee_price = entry × (1 ± 2×TAKER_FEE), live be_price = avgOpen × (1 ± 2×fee_rate); Bitunix real taker 0.05%/side so RT = 0.10%. Never bare entry — a BE close must net ≥ $0 after fees. Core trail / SL math unchanged; Core / Desk / Bias untouched.
